## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Reference related issues.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. For UI changes attach rendered evidence; for performance changes state the device/fixture and comparison. Identify checks not run.

## Compatibility and data

Describe any effect on stored history, pending events, schema/import/backup formats, signing, provider configuration or privacy disclosures. Omit this section when irrelevant.

Build and release workflows remain manual; a pull request does not authorize publication.
